sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(1), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
